L'égaliseur de mastering parallèle Mid/S: The parallel Mid/Side mastering EQ: weight, air and density, without closing up your mix.
ECLIPSE, c'est l'EQ que tu poses sur ton: ECLIPSE is the EQ you put on your mix bus, your vocal bus or your beat when you want everything to sound bigger.
Ses bandes LOW, MID et HIGH travaillent: Its LOW, MID and HIGH bands work in parallel, like on passive mastering equalisers. When you push, they blend instead of stacking up: you can boost the low end and the air boldly, your mix stays open.
Le MID CONTOUR redessine tes médiums d'u: The MID CONTOUR reshapes your mids in a single move. It scoops the centre and lifts the sides, or the other way round. Perfect for removing a mix's boxiness without hollowing it out.
Une seule série de réglages pour le cent: A single set of controls for the centre and the sides. With OFFSET, you add air on the sides or keep your 808 firmly in the centre, without touching the rest.
Plus tu pousses une bande, plus elle col: The harder you push a band, the more colour it adds: subtle for polish, generous when you want character. XFORMER adds a transformer's grain, mostly in the low end.
Pour contrôler ton travail : SOLO MID et: To check your work: SOLO MID and SIDE, DELTA to hear only what you change, MONO, WIDTH, a VU meter, and AUTO GAIN to compare at equal loudness.
